mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS MoM decline > 1% does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO 3-month decline does not correlate with subsequent supply-side issues.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 300,000 does not correlate with subsequent labor market strength.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with restrictive policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market stress.
